# EditorSaves

> EditorSaves is a game save-file collection and format-research project working toward a future universal game save editor.

## Current product status

The live website currently provides a save-file submission workflow. It validates the filename extension and file size, verifies an anti-abuse token on the server, calculates a SHA-256 content hash, stores eligible submissions in a private Supabase Storage bucket, and records upload metadata.

The current release does **not** parse save contents for visitors, modify money or inventory, edit game progress, or export modified save files. An accepted filename extension is an intake rule, not a claim that the format or game is currently editable.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://editorsaves.com/): Contribute eligible game save files to format research.
- [About](https://editorsaves.com/about): Project mission and research approach.
- [Contact](https://editorsaves.com/contact): Contact the project.
- [Privacy Policy](https://editorsaves.com/privacy): Data collection, storage, and retention information.
- [Terms of Use](https://editorsaves.com/terms): Upload rules and service limitations.
- [Blog](https://editorsaves.com/blog): Placeholder for future articles; no published articles are currently available.

## Filename extensions accepted by the current upload intake

.rpgsave, .rmmzsave, .save, .rvdata2, .rvdata, .rxdata, .sav, .dat, .json, .xml, .sqlite, .db, .plr, .wld, .rsv, .sol, .sgs, .qsp, .ksd, .pkl, .pickle, .es3, .lsd.

These extensions are accepted by the current intake filter only. Actual format identification and editor compatibility have not been implemented for the live product. Different games can use the same extension with unrelated internal structures.

## Research direction

The project intends to study save-file structure, serialization, compression, encoding, game and version differences, and validation requirements. Future editor support should be reported per game and format with tested limitations rather than inferred from the filename extension.
